description: AI Natural Language Data Queries - Enhance the AI chat to query connected data sources and render inline charts based on natural language questions
steps: 1. Enhance dashboard/ai-chat.js: Extend the detectIntent() function and response system to handle data queries. When a user asks 'Show me Shopify revenue for last week', the chat should: (a) detect this is a data query, (b) pull actual data from the DataStore (if live data is available) or demo data, (c) render an inline mini-chart in the chat response.

2. Add inline chart rendering to the AI chat: Create a renderInlineChart(data, type) function that generates a small Chart.js canvas inside the chat message bubble. Support line charts for time-series data (revenue over time) and bar charts for comparisons.

3. Add data query intents: Expand the intent detection to handle queries like: 'revenue this week', 'top products', 'lead sources breakdown', 'compare this week vs last week', 'GitHub activity summary'. Map each to the appropriate DataStore key.

4. Connect to live DataStore: When ConnectorManager.demoMode is false and live data exists, use real DataStore values in responses instead of static SAMPLE_RESPONSES. Format numbers with proper currency/comma formatting.

5. Add a server-side AI query endpoint: Add POST /api/intelligence/query to server/routes/intelligence.js that accepts a natural language question and returns structured data for charting. For now this can be rule-based (no external AI API needed) - parse the question, determine the metric, and return the relevant data shape.
6. Add test for the query endpoint in the existing server/routes/intelligence.test.js.
7. Add CSS for inline charts in chat: .ai-inline-chart class with appropriate sizing (max-width: 300px, height: 150px), rounded corners, and theme-aware colors.
8. Run npm test and npm run build to verify.
acceptance_criteria: Asking 'Show me revenue for last week' in AI chat returns a response with an inline line chart
Asking 'top products' returns a formatted list (or bar chart) of product data
When live data is connected, responses use real DataStore values
When in demo mode, responses use demo data with clear labeling
Inline charts are responsive and respect the current theme colors
Server query endpoint returns structured data for known metric queries
verification: Run npm test and confirm all tests pass (including new intelligence query test)
Run npm run build and confirm it succeeds
findings: All 282 tests pass (4 new tests for the query endpoint). Build succeeds. The query endpoint is protected by requireAuth middleware like all other intelligence routes.
